answers.text: "W 18.0% above weekly swing high; template c2 fails." Distance from an old weekly swing high and the c2 stack test are not my tests. C5 asks for an uptrend, a normal pullback, then a new high: W HH/HL, D HH/HL 2.4% under its swing high, a pause. I never regret missing the lower entry (C5). I buy only the next closing high, not this bar.

"H1 below EMA9 at 3% of range: test rejected." My test is the size of the reaction, not the hourly average. H1 swing high 181.3 to close 177.88 is under one atr_14d (4.15, my translation of the danger signal, C7): a normal reaction (C8). D HH/HL at its swing high. No closing new high yet, so my trigger has not fired; it is not refuted.

trigger.plain: An hourly close above yesterday's high holds the fresh break.

decisions.wrong_if: A one-day fade of 1 atr from the day's high (my translated danger signal) or a close back under pivot_high.
decisions.reason: C5 met: D HH/HL 0.5% above the last swing high, H1 above EMA9, 0.9% under the 20-day high. W swing LH/LL keeps conviction modest.

trigger.plain: A daily close above the last confirmed pivot high is the new high.

decisions.wrong_if: A close back under pivot_high after the break, or a one-day fade of 1 atr from the high.
decisions.reason: W HH/HL 2.8% above its swing high; D 0.1% under the last swing high: one close from the C5 new high. H1 at 7% of range is a normal reaction.

trigger.plain: An hourly close above yesterday's high continues the daily new high.

decisions.wrong_if: A one-day fade of 1 atr from the day's high, or a close below ma_20.
decisions.reason: D 6.3% above the last swing high and 0.9% under the 20-day high, H1 HH/HL above EMA9. W still 7.1% under its swing high; sub-$30 so my thresholds are scaled.

decisions.wrong_if: A daily close at a new 52-week closing high that I sat out.
decisions.reason: W and D HH/HL, but mp FADING/DECELERATING and H1 below EMA9 at 13% of range: a strong rally, not yet the confirmed trend at a new high my columns need.

trigger.plain: Only a daily close at a new 52-week closing high ends the reaction.

decisions.wrong_if: A close below ma_20 before the new high prints.
decisions.reason: Uptrend, but D 7.5% under its swing high (HH but LL) and W LH/LL: inside a reaction. C5 forbids buying the pullback; I wait for the new high.

trigger.plain: An hourly close above yesterday's high carries the new high on.

decisions.wrong_if: A one-day fade of 1 atr from the day's high, or a close below prior_bar_low.
decisions.reason: W and D HH/HL, 0.5% under the 20-day high, H1 above EMA9 at 72% of range; JNJ beside it in Healthcare (C14). mp FADING/DECELERATING is the weight.

trigger.plain: A daily close at a new 52-week closing high after this reaction.

decisions.wrong_if: A close below ma_20 or a one-day fade of 1 atr.
decisions.reason: D HH/HL but 4.8% under its 20-day high, H1 below EMA9 at 7% of range, W LH but HL: a reaction, not the new high. I wait for it (C5).
